title: プログラミング基礎
subtitle: Computer Programming Basic
educationalGoal: This course corresponds to the basic IT ability to create information for the use of management, which is a learning/education goal of the Department of Management Information. As preparation for actual computer programming, students will be given a bird's-eye view of programming and an understanding of many of the basic terms and concepts of programming, such as conditional branching, control, and algorithms.
advice: The purpose of this class is to provide lectures and simple exercises and quizzes to prepare students for programming. After the basic concepts, etc., are explained in the lecture, students will be given quizzes to confirm their comprehension as well as practical exercises that facilitate their understanding of the concepts and encourage the acquisition of programming thinking skills. The exercises use Excel VBA (Visual Basic Application) that can be used with Microsoft Excel, the most widely used application software in business.
books: Textbooks will be announced before class starts.
requiredKnowledge: Students must complete the exercises. Students must bring their laptop computer to each class meeting.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain variables and data types.
Be able to create flowcharts using basic controls such as branching and repetition.
Be able to define an array and assign variables using Excel VBA.
Be able to define functions using arguments.
